summary: Completed backend testing of race-code-scoped endpoints. All 27 tests passed. Fixed MongoDB projection error in subscribe endpoint. All reset endpoints (reset-database, reset-cheers, reset-subscriptions) correctly filter by active race_code (BYSD-2027) and return race_code in response. Subscribe and cheer endpoints include race_code in new records.

reset-cheers correctly deletes only cheer_messages with race_code=BYSD-2027
reset-subscriptions correctly deletes only email_subscriptions with race_code=BYSD-2027
send-runner-emails correctly queries registrations with race_code=BYSD-2027
subscribe endpoint includes race_code in new subscriptions
cheer endpoint includes race_code in new cheer messages
All reset endpoints return race_code in response for confirmation
